name: Drills by Lamplight
description: A Millelith soldier seems to be troubled by something...

dialogs.content: Surely that Sergeant isn't the one in charge... Well, good luck to them, then, they're gonna need it...
Is something the matter?
#Huh!? Oh, it's you, {NICKNAME}... Phew...
You scared me there! I thought the Sergeant had come over. If he overheard me, I'd get dragged away for more training...
Do you guys... still have to train?
Well, the bigger the festival, the busier we are.
Liyue Harbor is huge, and there are so many tourists coming in from all over the world.
To maintain order and ensure everyone's safety, the Millelith have set up quite a few new mobile units both in the city and in the wilderness.
Do you know what a mobile unit is? Hmm... just think of it as a team of Millelith soldiers who provide help wherever they go.
As long as you need help, just run up to a squad and ask for assistance, and they'll lend a hand.
Whether if you're in danger, lost something, or even got lost yourself, just go ask them for help.
But... since we need to cover such a large area, our Sergeant has even pulled out the reserve units that were originally on standby for training.
But those reserve units are all made up of rookies who haven't had much training. So the Sergeant said, why not hold a temporary training event to up their individual skill level?
I heard that... that particular Sergeant is really tough. Anyone who's been trained by him can't help but shiver when hearing his name...
You've... undergone his training too?
I—I suppose you could say that. His training is actually really effective, but my legs turn into jelly at the mere thought of it...
Want to give it a try? During my training, I heard him mention your name a lot. He said you're not only a master of tactical deployment, but also excel at hand-to-hand combat...
Were it you in the training arena, you'd definitely out-perform all of us.
I'd love to give it a try!
Alright. The courage you display... You're indeed the hero of Liyue. Then please, follow me.
Let me think it over a bit...
That's alright. Just let me know when you want to give it a whirl. I'm sure the Sergeant would be more than happy to have you.
Isn't it Lantern Rite now?
